name: 46216 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46216 (Indianapolis) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46216 (Indianapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
